rows.grounds: first member of time expression with samaye
specifies when the action is performed
first member of duration expression with divasaṃ
indicates duration of the prescribed action
specifies the place of the action

items.question: What writing ritual must be performed at dusk on the ground for three days?
premises: A prior action is completed, indicated by kṛtvā.
The prescribed action is writing, expressed by likhet.
The writing must occur at dusk time, for three days, on the ground.
items.inference: After completing the prior rite, one should perform the writing at dusk on the ground for three days.
uncertainties: The object to be written is not specified in this verse and must be supplied from context.
items.plain_english: Having done that, one should write at dusk on the ground for three days.
